content.comment_body: Hello, I want to obtain the current hour from [product_name] and store it in VW1 to compare with VW2, but I can't figure out how to retrieve the time directly. Thanks!

Hi, You could use an operating hour counter or program your own time tracking instead. For example, increment a counter each second, minute, or hour when a signal is ON, and then compare the values. Accessing the built-in clock directly is not possible. Hope this clarifies.

Hello! It's unfortunate that it's not possible to use the astro clock variable (for seconds, minutes, hours, day, month, year). Do you think future firmware will include this? Because of this feature missing, I may need to select another compact PLC. Your suggested workaround might not stay synchronized with the real clock. Currently, I'm using [product_name] [article_no] to manage power consumption in my factory. I'll include what I achieved with another small PLC. Thanks!

Hi, If I understand correctly, you want to record information along with date and time. Have you considered data logging? This always records the timestamp and value you select, which can be stored in internal memory or on the SD card. You can read from internal memory and the last data log on SD card using [product_name] V7. If you restart [product_name] and log to SD card, each power cycle generates a new data log file. To access old files, you need to remove the SD card and connect it to your PC. The file is in CSV format, so programs like Excel can open it. Keep in mind, [product_name] is a basic controller, so not every PLC feature will be available. If you have a working solution, consider sticking with it. Never change a working system! Hope this helps.

Hello, Yes, I already have a solution using another non-[company_name] small PLC, but I won’t name it here. I thought [product_name] [article_no] with its Ethernet port and 850 byte memory would be a more economical choice. Thank you for your reply.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is dissatisfied because they cannot access or store the real-time clock hour directly for comparison, seeing this as a missing feature compared to other compact PLCs. The community provides alternative methods, but these do not meet the user's expectation for direct clock variable access within [product_name]. This limitation affects the perceived usefulness of the device and is seen as a missed opportunity given its hardware capabilities.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to be able to directly access current time variables (such as hour) within [product_name] for use in programming logic, similar to what is possible with competing devices.
